entries.note: The CLI extracts legacy sealed-room blobs. It does not open a workspace folder.
These are the legacy blob primitives used by BlobContentStore. Higher layers must choose the room content abstraction before calling them.
The hybrid recording path documents and enforces that recovered workspace WAV bytes stay out of the legacy blob column.
The nullable column remains for old rooms. Workspace rows must keep it NULL.
Legacy blob version snapshots read this column. WorkspaceService uses encrypted content objects instead.
The hybrid transcript edit path documents that workspace snapshots must not copy current audio into the legacy blob column.
Conversion streams source blobs, verifies them, and clears the column only in the new workspace copy.
The reference documents the invariant; workspace reads and writes are routed to WorkspaceService.
Sealed import projects current files into normal files and explicitly stores NULL in workspace rows.
This aggregate reports bytes still owned by the legacy blob store.
All workspace inserts write NULL. Current bytes are written only to normal files.

knownIndirectBlobAssumptions.reason: Chat attachment ingestion still inserts uploaded image and document bytes through legacy blob primitives.
Knowledge command artifacts still call the synchronous legacy Artifact.commit path instead of commitToWorkspace.
The streamed-answer save path still publishes generated notes through the legacy database file store.
Story and cast helpers still read generated image references through the legacy byte column.
